$comment: Direction 2 (now vs lifetime + warning signs) feasibility research, 2026-11-06, Google Maps only, work account (authuser=1), UI hl=ja (second pass hl=en for translations). Reviews were read PASSIVELY from the page's own responses while the review list was scrolled with newest sort: a main-world wrapper on window.fetch (installed after page load) cloned every /maps/_/MapsWizUi/data/batchexecute response containing rpc qv9Egd. Nothing was replayed or requested by hand. Harness: scratch d2scrape.js (eval-injected, results POSTed to a localhost CORS server). Review and owner-reply text is removed ("[removed]"); field paths, counts and our notes stay.

partA.store: 鳥良商店 南池袋店 (0x60188d681355b373:0x984160981caefe27), newest sort, first 100 reviews (170 scraped within 24 months in 20.8 s)

passiveSource.transport: fetch POST /maps/_/MapsWizUi/data/batchexecute, rpcids=qv9Egd; body ')]}\'' + length-prefixed chunks; chunk[0][i] = ['wrb.fr','qv9Egd', <JSON string>]. NOT listugcposts (that name never appears in the page's traffic now). The XHRs seen alongside are 204 logging pings.
passiveSource.perResponse: 10 reviews; inner = JSON.parse(chunk[2]); inner[1] = next-page token, inner[2][i][0] = review
passiveSource.readableBy: window.fetch wrapper in the main world (javascript tool), set up after load; Response.prototype.text hook also sees it. read_network_requests did not list it by 'ugc'.

paths.lastEditedMicros: r[1][3]  (µs epoch; newest sort orders by THIS)
paths.originalLanguage: r[2][14][0]  (ja, en, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, fr, de, ru, th ...)
paths.translatedText: r[2][15][1][0]  (into the UI language: present for 1836/1837 non-UI-language reviews on the hl=en pass, 800/801 non-ja on hl=ja)
paths.guidedDining: r[2][6][k]: key q[0][0] e.g. GUIDED_DINING_FOOD_ASPECT; aspect score q[11][0]; choice answers q[2][0][m][1] (label) with code q[2][0][m][0][0] e.g. 'E:LUNCH', 'E:JPY_1_TO_1000'; DISH_RECOMMENDATION choices carry a menu entity 'M:/g/...' and the dish name
paths.ownerReply: r[3]: text r[3][14][0][0], language r[3][13][0], time r[3][1] (µs), relative r[3][3]; r[3] exists (with report/edit links) even when there is no reply, so test the text
paths.reviewer: r[1][4][5]: name [0], profile id [3], review count [5], photo count [6], Local Guide flag [8][0], level [8][1], label [10][0] ('ローカルガイド · クチコミ 488 件')
paths.unknown: r[4][2]: small integer that grows with review age (not likes; meaning unknown)

notFound: like / helpful count (no liked review in the sample; path unknown)

fieldShares_first100.originalLanguages: ja 42, en 13, ko 5, zh-Hant 4, de 2, ru 1, fr 1 (of 68 with text)

partA.domFallback: Same data in the DOM per div[data-review-id]: body .MyEned .wiI7pd, owner reply .CDe7pd .wiI7pd, stars [role=img][aria-label], date .rsqaWe, reviewer line .RfnDt ('ローカルガイド · 25 件のクチコミ'), guided-dining answers as plain text blocks ('食事: 5', 'サービス: 5', '1 人あたりの料金 ￥1,000～2,000') that are truncated with '…' until expanded; translation toggle [jsaction*=review.showReviewInOriginal]. Obfuscated classes: prefer the payload.
partA.datePrecision: YES: exact microsecond publish and last-edit timestamps in the payload (and owner-reply timestamp). The DOM only has the relative string. Newest sort is by last edit, so an old review edited recently shows up at the top as '最終編集: N 前' (9% of reviews were edited).
partA.uiLanguage: Payload carries original + translation whatever hl is, so no clicking is needed. For the DOM: hl=ja shows Japanese originals as-is and only non-ja reviews translated (toggle 'Google による翻訳 ・ 原文を見る（英語）'); hl=en shows ja reviews translated into English with 'Translated by Google ・ See original (Japanese)'. Account default (zh-TW UI) translates the Japanese majority (from the 2026-10-30 notes, not re-measured).
partA.scrapeSpeed: ≈10 reviews per scroll step, 0.9 s wait: 100–240 reviews in 13–55 s; 330 reviews/18 months 157 s. 4 tabs in parallel worked (all tabs report visible).
partA.translationPairs: Open the place with hl=en and read r[2][15][0][0] (original) and r[2][15][1][0] (English) for the same r[0]; Google keeps line breaks, so line-by-line alignment worked whenever line counts match (112 of 256 corpus items are single aligned lines).

stores.name: 大戸屋ごはん処 池袋東口店
stores.story: Station-front 大戸屋 slid from 3.98 (12-18 mo ago) to 3.15 in the last 3 months: slow service, wrong/undercooked dishes, free refills of the breakfast rice ended.

stores.name: 東京油組総本店 池袋組
stores.story: Abura-soba shop at 3.8 lifetime drops to 3.22 in the last 3 months, driven by three separate cockroach reports (one staff member crushed it by hand) and rude service.

stores.name: 舎鈴 池袋東口店
stores.story: Tsukemen chain branch: 12-month average 3.23 vs 3.6 lifetime; complaints about rude staff and lukewarm soup; one reviewer notes things improved after Matsuya took over the parent company.

stores.name: 魚金池袋店
stores.story: Seafood izakaya: 12-month 3.37 vs 3.7; the most consistent surprise-charge complaints of all stores (お通し 500円 + サービス料 5%), plus slow, unfriendly service.
stores.broke: First run did not switch to newest sort (unordered list); fixed by re-checking order after the sort click.

stores.name: 東池袋 大勝軒 南池袋店
stores.story: Tsukemen shop of a famous lineage: 12-month 2.82 vs 3.2 lifetime (12-18 mo ago 2.25, last 3 months 3.2). Long-time customers report price rises (もりそば 1,150円), smaller servings and a taste that is 'no longer Taishoken'.

stores.name: つけ麺専門店 三田製麺所 池袋西口店
stores.story: Chain tsukemen: 12-month 3.27 vs 3.6; regulars say the dipping soup got thinner. Owner replies are one boilerplate text (12 distinct openings in 66 replies) and once correct the customer about the noodle weight.

stores.name: 横浜家系ラーメン 池袋商店
stores.story: Iekei ramen: last 3 months 3.52 vs 3.9 lifetime ([quote removed]). Owner replies come from a template bank shared word-for-word with ラーメン豚山 and sometimes thank 2-star reviewers for their 'high rating'.
stores.broke: Sort check needed 4 tries on the hl=en pass.

stores.name: 皇綱家
stores.story: Iekei ramen with a 3.2 lifetime and 2.97 over the last 12 months (232 reviews). Clear warnings rather than a big swing: hygiene (23 low-star hits), rude manager, repeated price rises to 1,000円, and one reviewer alleging that bad reviews disappear while staff post good ones.
stores.broke: Hit maxN=400 before reaching 24 months (126 s); 12-month buckets are complete.

stores.name: ラーメン豚山 池袋西口店
stores.story: Jiro-style ramen: last 3 months 3.5 vs 3.8; complaints that the pork got thinner and the soup lukewarm. Owner replies 231/250, many seasonal templates that ignore the complaint (a hair in the food answered with 'enjoy the heat, recharge with our ramen').

stores.name: 瞠 池袋本店
stores.story: Abura-soba shop drifting down: 4.28 (12-18 mo ago) → 3.95 (12 mo) → 3.72 (3 mo); reviewers say the taste fell over the last few years.

stores.name: 座・麻婆唐府 池袋店
stores.story: Sichuan restaurant re-opened after リニューアル: 64 reviews in 3 months averaging 4.53 vs 3.6 lifetime, many saying it is better than before. Caveat: the burst is dominated by long, dish-by-dish 5★ reviews from Chinese-writing Local Guides naming the same dishes; a few reviewers say the chef/menu changed and old favourites disappeared.

stores.name: 中国家庭料理 池袋 楊
stores.story: Chinese home cooking famous from 孤独のグルメ: 3.6 (12-18 mo ago) → 3.91 (12 mo) → 4.0 (3 mo) vs 3.7 lifetime; still some rude-staff complaints. Owner replies are short and plug the Instagram account.

stores.name: 北前そば高田屋 池袋西口店
stores.story: Soba izakaya chain: 12-month 4.16 vs 3.8 lifetime; owner replies to every review (120/120) in the reviewer's language. Remaining complaints are about service.

stores.name: 肉野菜炒めベジ郎 池袋東口店
stores.story: Vegetable stir-fry shop: last 3 months 4.43 vs 3.8 lifetime, older 3.54; small sample (21) and gradual price creep (ジリジリ値上げ) mentioned.

stores.name: タイストリートフードbyクルン・サイアム 池袋店
stores.story: Thai street food in the station: several reviewers note prices went up (now over 1,000円) yet stay satisfied; rating stable (12-month 3.83 vs 4.0). Owner replies to complaints are exemplary: they report a fact check with the manager.

stores.name: 横浜家系らーめん 武蔵家 池袋店
stores.story: Iekei ramen: ラーメン 100円値上げ and the end (then return) of free rice are discussed without anger; 12-month 3.4 ≈ 3.5 lifetime, last 3 months 4.33. One recent 4★ review is a pasted chatbot answer with both a 'Googleマップ用' and a '食べログ用' version.

stores.name: 滝野川 大勝軒
stores.story: Taishoken branch with a loved owner: 価格改定 to 1,200円 accepted ([quote removed]); 12-month 3.92 vs 3.8. Caveat: last 3 months 3.35 because of complaints about one blond staff member.

stores.name: 頑者 TOKYO UNDERGROUND RAMEN 池袋
stores.story: Tsukemen shop: 3.69 / 3.62 / 3.67 (3 mo / 12 mo / older) vs 3.7 lifetime; complaints are ordinary service grumbles, no trend.

stores.name: さかば ふくろ
stores.story: Classic all-day izakaya: 3.89 / 3.93 / 4.0 vs 3.9; お通し mentioned as acceptable, praise and complaints about the older waitresses balance out.

stores.name: 大都会
stores.story: Cheap standing-bar style izakaya: 3.83 / 3.76 / 3.77 vs 3.8; several reviewers note food and drink prices rose but it is 'still cheap' — a control for the price classifier.

extras.name: 鳥良商店 南池袋店
extras.note: 鳥良商店 南池袋店: last 3 months 4.57 (n=37) vs 3.6 lifetime; 43% of those reviewers have ≤2 reviews and up to 7 reviews landed on one day. Payload-only signals; text shows no reward wording. Owner replies to 165/170 with templates shared word-for-word with 磯丸水産 (same group); a zh-Hant complaint about an unannounced 前菜費 for foreigners got a generic Chinese template.

extras.name: 鹿児島県霧島市 塚田農場 池袋西口公園店
extras.note: 塚田農場 池袋西口公園店 (4.6, 629 reviews): 182 reviews in the last 3 months (≈29% of its lifetime count), 87% 5★, 64% from accounts with ≤2 reviews, 17 on a single day, and 49/127 texts praise a named staff member. No reward wording found — a model-free 'campaign' signal.

extras.name: 良心的大衆酒場 鶴亀八番 池袋店
extras.note: 良心的大衆酒場 鶴亀八番 池袋店 (4.8, 1,067): 4.88 over 220 reviews in 12 months, 73% of last-3-month reviewers have ≤2 reviews, 11 on one day, owner replies to 219/220.

extras.name: 鉢鉢香
extras.note: 鉢鉢香 (3.6, 234): only 23 reviews in 12 months, so below the size bar, but the clearest dismissive owner replies found (in Chinese).

extras.name: 東京豚骨拉麺 ばんから 池袋東口店
extras.note: 東京豚骨拉麺 ばんから 池袋東口店 (3.5, 1,185): last 3 months 4.52 vs 3.5; very long, self-flagellating replies to complaints and a 1★ 'the chuka soba changed' thanked for its 'high rating'; a reviewer mentions touts handing out free-egg coupons outside.

warningCategoryCounts.$comment: keywordHits = regex hits in ≤3★ reviews of the last 12 months over the 20 stores (noisy, overlapping); corpusComplaints = hand-labelled complaint items in direction2-corpus.json

surprises: Passive payload works: exact µs timestamps, original language, original + translated text, sub-ratings, price band, owner reply + time, reviewer stats; 10 reviews per response.
Newest sort is by last-edit time; edited reviews (9%) jump to the top with their old publish date in r[1][2].

Owner-reply template banks are shared across stores of the same group word-for-word (ラーメン豚山 ↔ 横浜家系ラーメン 池袋商店: identical texts; 鳥良商店 ↔ 磯丸水産; ばんから 東口 ↔ 本店). Some templates ignore the content (hair in food → seasonal greeting; 2★ thanked for 'high rating').

Solicited-review bursts are visible without any language model: share of reviews from ≤2-review accounts, max reviews per day, share of 5★, staff names in text (塚田農場 64% / 17 per day / 49 staff-name texts in 3 months; 鶴亀八番 73% / 11 per day).
A Local Guide (349 reviews) pasted a chatbot answer verbatim, with a 'Googleマップ用' and a '食べログ用' version, as a 4★ review (武蔵家).
Guided-dining sub-ratings (food/service/atmosphere) exist on 82% of reviews: a 'service is slipping' trend can be computed from numbers alone.
No explicit 'review for a freebie' wording in ~7,000 reviews of 45 stores; the closest is touts handing out free-egg coupons (ばんから 東口).
Foreign-staff complaints are a frequent, sensitive pattern in low-star reviews; a classifier should not turn 'foreign staff' into a warning by itself.
didNotWork: Maps search [142] snippets were a weak shortlist signal (mostly positive quotes): measuring every candidate was faster and better.
Newest-sort click sometimes did not apply (list stayed in relevance order) — detect by checking that edit times decrease, then re-click.
Review list sometimes not rendered until the panel scroller is nudged (Mo's Cafe).
Scrolling stalls on very active stores (鶴亀八番, 塚田農場 stopped at ~220 reviews / ~12 months).
Stores under ~500 lifetime reviews rarely reach 40 text reviews in 12 months (Mo's Cafe, カレーは飲み物, 鉢鉢香, アニメイトカフェ).
Claude-in-Chrome disconnected once mid-batch; recovered on retry.
